app.name: d2x cIOS installer
app.coder: dragbe, with d2x by davebaol, blackb0x and Monsterray
app.long_description:
Installs the d2x v11.1.0 custom IOS, for USB Loader GX, Nintendont and other homebrew.
d2x v11.1.0 makes a USB drive that stops answering fail fast instead of freezing the Wii, recovers write errors, turns on SD high speed and fixes the MLOAD, FAT and DIP modules. See Changelog.txt.
Slots and bases: 249 on base 56 for most games, 250 on base 57 for USB loaders, 248 on base 38, 251 on base 58. On a vWii, use ciosmaps-vWii.xml as ciosmaps.xml. Wii Mini bases (57 v31775, v31776) are in the map but untested on hardware. See ReadMe.txt.
No warranty. This writes to the NAND: have a backup first. github.com/Monsterray/d2x-cios
